## Pages

The site is organized as three "rooms":

- https://chancelloredwards.dev/ — Fountain Clock (landing + résumé: experience, skills, education)
- https://chancelloredwards.dev/playground.html — Playground (writing: essays and notes read from the journal archive's public API)
- https://chancelloredwards.dev/notes.html — Notes (private, local-first micro-vault; no indexable content)
